items.prompt: On prices [2,4,4,7], bisect_right for 4 gives 3. Why is that wrong for this task?

options.text: The returned 3 is not an integer index.
options.why: It is an index, but it identifies the wrong boundary.

options.text: Every binary search must reject duplicate prices.
options.why: Duplicates are valid and are exactly why the lower boundary matters.

options.text: It skips equal 4 values instead of returning their first index 1.
options.why: The required partition is values<target versus values>=target.

options.text: It moves every equal price to a new position.
options.why: Searching computes a position without moving array elements.

items.explanation: The required partition is values<target versus values>=target.
